auth_details: API access token via Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY header (token only — do not use Bearer). Create personal or service tokens in Account/Organization settings; project-scoped tokens available.
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor correct. Official docs state the Authorization header value must be the access token itself, not a Bearer scheme. REST guide curl examples use Authorization: EXAMPLE-API-ACCESS-TOKEN with no Bearer prefix (https://launchdarkly.com/docs/api ; https://launchdarkly.com/docs/guides/api/rest-api).
